source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Θεόδωρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole notice of him is one sentence. There is no country, no century, no emperor, no year and no hymn. The folder is marked by its day because the page gives him nothing else to be known by. The page of «Αγία Ελέσα» on this same day names an «Όσιος Θεόδωρος» as patron of Kythira together with her; that is a different notice and a different man and nothing here is claimed about the two. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
